name: voxel-tactics
description: XCOM 2-style present-day co-op tactics on a voxel battlefield (gameplay grid) drawn with a modern pre-baked tile set.

scripts.build: npm run content:sync && npm run build --workspace=client
scripts.test: npm run content:check && node --test shared/voxel/*.test.js shared/elements/*.test.js shared/battle/*.test.js shared/mission/*.test.js shared/mapgen/*.test.js shared/session/*.test.js client/src/render/kit/*.test.js server/test/*.test.js
scripts.test:fast: node --test shared/voxel/*.test.js shared/elements/*.test.js shared/battle/*.test.js shared/mission/*.test.js shared/mapgen/*.test.js shared/session/*.test.js client/src/render/kit/*.test.js
